The '''long-handle lightsaber''', also known as a '''lightsaber staff''' and '''lightsaber cane''', was a variation of the traditional [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with a handle several times longer than that of a standard lightsaber. Requiring a particular fighting style from the wielder, this weapon was easy to swing around the body, using joints of the body as fulcrums upon which the lightsaber could be levered.

However, like most [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsabers]], the long handle presumably meant that opposing duelists could target the handle itself to great effect.

==History==
[[File:Bpfasshi_Dark_Jedi.jpg|thumb|left|160px|A Bpfasshi Dark Jedi wielding a long-handle lightsaber.]]
[[Darth Chratis]], a Sith Lord who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], used a staff that could become a long-handle lightsaber.

One of the [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] defeated by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] used a long-handle lightsaber made of an as-yet unknown material. Jedi Master [[Zao]] used a lightsaber with a hilt that was also a long [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] [[Cane/Legends|cane]], which the blind [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] used to help him get around. Jedi Master [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] also used a long-handled lightsaber to fit his tall frame.

This type of lightsaber was favored by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihl]], whose lightsaber was long and staff-like in appearance. The handle seemed to be made not of metal, but almost of wood or coral (possibly of [[Yorik coral]] as in others lightsaber hilts of the [[One Sith]]). On the opposite end to the [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]] was a ring big enough to fit Nihl's hand. Nihl used this lightsaber to [[Cho mok/Legends|cut off]] [[Wolf Sazen]]'s right [[Limb/Legends|arm]] at the shoulder.
